answer_1.quote: Multimodal summarization (MS) for videos aims at integrating multimodal information ... to generate text summaries. ... Given a video and its corresponding transcript in the source language (e.g., Portuguese) as inputs, the goal of the MCLS system is to generate an abstractive summary in the target language (e.g., English).

answer_2.quote: BLEU (1,2,3,4) , ROUGE (1,2,L) , METEOR  and CIDEr  are adopted as the evaluation metrics to comprehensively analyze the model performance.
